qa.recommendation: Do not enter a planned retirement year for units 1, 2 and 3 at this time.
qa.note: Constellation sent PJM a deactivation notice on June 22, 2026 for Zion units 1, 2 and 3, effective December 31, 2029, to meet the Illinois Climate and Equitable Jobs Act. PJM replied that the plant is needed and asked for operation through May 2031. On July 2, 2026 Constellation wrote that it intends to withdraw the notice and take part in the capacity auctions for those years. The letter says a formal withdrawal will follow, and I did not find it. So the 2029 date is no longer the owner's plan. Please recheck the PJM page for the formal withdrawal.

qa.recommendation: Keep Zion Energy LLC as owner at 100 percent. Consider adding Constellation Energy Generation LLC as the parent.
qa.note: Constellation's June 2026 letter to PJM says Constellation Energy Generation, LLC is the upstream owner of Zion Energy LLC, which owns and operates the plant. The EIA table for August 2026 still lists Zion Energy LLC as the owner. So the owning entity did not change. Only the parent changed after the Calpine purchase closed on January 7, 2026. The parent is a computed field, so I did not report it as a value. The entity lookup found no entity named Constellation Energy or Constellation Energy Generation in the local export, so the parent entity may need to be checked in the entity system.
